summary: Retry transient Bitcoin RPC failures during native balance-history bootstrap
details: Opt in only the native-bootstrap client to six attempts per block count, hash or payload read, with cancellable 2/4/8/16/20 second backoffs and retry/recovery/exhaustion diagnostics. Normal service clients retain their existing behavior.

Classify typed transport failures, Core warmup and temporary HTTP availability errors conservatively. Authentication, malformed responses, invalid parameters and canonical identity violations remain hard failures.

Recover individual reads without re-running database writes or completed in-process verification scans. Recheck the pinned origin after the final height read before sealing, including after RPC recovery. Preserve resumable staging on cancellation or exhaustion; unsealed verification may still repeat after a process restart.
operator_actions: Upgrade the matching usdb-services image through the normal release procedure; no configuration change or data rebuild is required.
For repeated Native bootstrap RPC retries exhausted messages, inspect Bitcoin logs and resource history for persistent RPC, memory or disk pressure.
